f.title: Notify serious adverse events immediately as complete ICSRs, at the latest 24 hours for critical cases
f.statement: Every serious adverse event must be notified individually and immediately; for critical situations (death, life-threatening situations, major unexpected events) at the latest within 24 hours of becoming aware of the case. These cases must be transmitted as complete individual case safety reports (ICSRs) in accordance with the procedures and formats in force.
f.applicability: Serious adverse events related to the use of medical products in Cameroon

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (also promotion agency managers and wholesale distributors)
rows.deadline: Immediately; at the latest 24 hours after becoming aware of the case for critical situations (death, life-threatening, major unexpected events)
rows.quote:
-Cas graves (ICSR :Rapport individuel de sécurité): Tout événement
indésirable grave doit faire l'objet d'une notification individuelle immédiate,
ceci au plus tard dans les 24 heures suivant la prise de connaissance du
cas pour les situations critiques (décès, menace du pronostic vital,
événements inattendus majeurs) .Ces cas doivent être transmis sous forme
de fiches individuelles complètes (ICSR), conformément aux procédures et
formats en vigueur ;
rows.review_note: Review: 'doit/doivent' = Mandatory; quote_en checked against the official English version of the same letter, which agrees in meaning and deadline. Origin not distinguished by the source (any). Double-check: the 24-hour limit is stated only for critical situations; other serious cases are 'immédiate' with no number, so the rule's applies_to is limited accordingly. Actor list from the letter's addressees.
rows.quote_en: - Serious Cases (ICSR: Individual Case Safety Report): All serious adverse events must be reported individually immediately, and no later than 24 hours after becoming aware of the case for critical situations (death, life-threatening situations, major unexpected events). These cases must be submitted as complete Individual Case Safety Reports (ICSRs), in accordance with current procedures and formats;

f.title: Submit non-serious adverse events monthly as a line listing by the 5th of the following month
f.statement: Non-serious adverse events must be compiled as a line listing and transmitted monthly, at the latest on the 5th of the month following the notification period.
f.topic: Periodic line listing of non-serious cases
f.applicability: Non-serious adverse events related to the use of medical products in Cameroon

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (also promotion agency managers and wholesale distributors)
rows.deadline: Monthly, at the latest on the 5th of the month following the notification period
rows.quote:
-Cas non graves (Line listing) : Les événements indésirables non graves
doivent être compilés sous forme de line listing et transmis de manière
mensuelle, ceci au plus tard le 5 du mois suivant la période de
notification.
rows.review_note: Review: 'doivent' = Mandatory; agrees with the official English version. No deadline_rule: the deadline is a recurring calendar day, not a fixed number of days or a fixed date. Double-check: OK.
rows.quote_en: - Non-Serious Cases (Line Listing): Non-serious adverse events must be compiled into a line listing and submitted monthly, no later than the 5th of the month following the notification period.

f.title: Send ICSRs and line listings to the national vigilance service mailbox
f.statement: The ICSRs and line listings described in the letter must be transmitted via the e-mail address designated by the Ministry of Public Health (vigilance service of the DPML).

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (also promotion agency managers and wholesale distributors)
rows.quote: Par ailleurs, les éléments suscités devront être transmis via l'adresse email
rows.review_note: Review: 'devront' = Mandatory. The e-mail address itself is omitted from the quote and statement (repository rule: no e-mail addresses); it is stated in the letter. Double-check: OK.
rows.quote_en: Furthermore, the aforementioned information must be sent to the email address [address designated in the letter].
